PR: https://github.com/Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization/pull/185

- Added a Cypress regression covering the case where YouTube helpers become available after the pipeline selector is already rendered.
- Updated PR 185 title/body and marked it ready for review.

- `git diff --check` passed.
- Full `cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` run: the new playlist regression and existing playlist creation test passed; 3 unrelated existing pipeline tests failed in stage navigation, relative publish dates, and full-album timestamps.

CI on PR 185 has started and was still in progress at the final check.

Implemented and pushed the follow-up fix to PR 185:

https://github.com/Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization/pull/185

What changed:
- `examples/youtube-upload.js` now owns a shared YouTube playlist selector renderer.
- `examples/pipeline.js` now uses that shared selector instead of duplicating playlist checkbox/create/refresh behavior.
- Added the requested case study under `docs/case-studies/issue-182` with issue/PR data, logs, timeline, root cause, and verification notes.
- Updated PR title/body and marked the PR ready for review.

Verification:
- `npm test -- --runTestsByPath tests/YouTubeUploader.test.ts` passed.
- `npm run build` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Full pipeline Cypress spec was run; the issue-specific playlist creation test passed. The full spec still has 2 unrelated existing failures in stage navigation and relative publish date assertions.

CI for the new pushed commit is still in progress:
